chapter: After the Paradise: club dates and Virginia
title: Town Hill, back to the Elegante and 35 weeks in West New York, NJ
summary: He lists the jobs after the Elegante, including Austin Powell and he hiring Hawkins, Stitt and Roy Eldridge in an old bank building over the Lincoln Tunnel.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So now, to go back, the Elegante, that was 1958?
And, after that was over, it was more club dates?

Yeah, in between. Then I went in the Town Hill for about a year and a half, after the Elegante. And then, after that, I left the Town Hill then I went back to the Elegante for a little while, about six or eight months. And then, you know, went back on to the club dates. Then I satrted workin' places in Long Island and, in between, the club dates. Then Austin and I we did about 35 weeks in West New York, New Jersey. And then I'd hire Coleman and Sonny Stitt, at that time, and we had Roy (Eldridge) over there. That was a period, you know...

Well, it was two partners and one...they used to be in show business, one played bass and the other played clarinet and so they were musicians, you know, Italian fellas. And it was an old bank building and they had a good crowd. Yeah, they really had somethin' there. That was 32 weeks, right over the Lincoln Tunnel. And then Austin and I we did some jobs in Long Island, then we did some things in Jersey, Newark.
